Part.Title: Tables of radionuclides and summation rules

P2para.Text: The Table 1 referred to in paragraph 4 of Part 2 (NORM industrial activities) is—

Tabular.Title: Concentration of radionuclides: NORM industrial activities

xhtml:th.Emphasis: Solid or relevant liquid concentration in becquerels per gram (Bq/g)
Any other liquid concentration in becquerels per litre (Bq/l)
Gaseous concentration in becquerels per cubic metre (Bq/m3)

P2para.Text: The Table 1 summation rule in respect of column 2, 3 or 4 means the sum of the quotients A/B where—

P3para.Text: “A” means the concentration of each radionuclide listed in column 1 of Table 1 that is present in the substance or article, and
“B” means the concentration of that radionuclide specified in column 2, 3 or 4 (as appropriate) of Table 1.

P2para.Text: The Table 2 referred to in paragraph 5 of Part 2 (processed radionuclides of natural terrestrial or cosmic origin) and paragraph 6 of that Part (radionuclides not of natural terrestrial or cosmic origin) is—

xhtml:td.Substitution: Any other solid or relevant liquid radionuclide that is not of natural terrestrial or cosmic origin

or that concentration which gives rise to a dose to a member of the public of 10 microsieverts per year calculated by reference to the International Atomic Energy Agency publication “Application of the Concepts of Exclusion, Exemption and Clearance”,

P2para.Text: The Table 2 column 2 summation rule means the sum of the quotients A/B where—

P3para.Text: “A” means the concentration of each radionuclide listed in column 1 of Table 2 that is present in the substance or article, and
“B” means the concentration of that radionuclide specified in column 2 of Table 2.

P1group.Title: References in Table 1 and Table 2 to + and sec

P1para.Text: Where any radionuclide carries the suffix “+” or “sec” in Table 1 or Table 2—

P3para.Text: that radionuclide represents the parent radionuclide in secular equilibrium with the corresponding daughter radionuclides which are identified in column 2 of Table 3 in respect of that parent radionuclide, and

a concentration value given in a table in this Part in respect of such a parent radionuclide is the value for the parent radionuclide alone, but already takes into account the daughter radionuclides present.
